Whether the three permissive policies are present or absent on any given target cannot be answered from the chain, because DB-002 found out-of-band application. This is the single largest reason the file is still worth applying rather than declaring the finding already closed, and it is why the migration's DROP statements are IF EXISTS rather than a comment claiming the target is already clean.

Whether `authenticated` actually holds table-level SELECT on public.organizations on the hosted project is NOT verified. The chain does not manage table grants in SQL. The new policies resolve org_id through an RLS-evaluated EXISTS on that table, so a missing grant makes them DENY — the safe direction, but a functional regression for org managers, which is why it is a preflight stop condition rather than an assumption.

scope_expansions.reason: Acceptance criterion 4 requires the cross-tenant denial to be PROVEN by a SQL test rather than asserted by inspection. A catalog contract test can only inspect pg_policies, so it cannot demonstrate that a cross-tenant read returns 0 rows, that an INSERT raises 42501, or that a worker still reads their own row. A behavioural harness was required, and the repo already had the pattern (supabase/tests/db011_interaction_scope.harness.sh) plus a shared auth/roles bootstrap to reuse.

READ-ONLY reuse, not edited. It already creates the auth schema, auth.users, auth.uid() and the anon/authenticated roles that any RLS harness on this table needs. It does not define auth.role(), so the harness defines that one function itself rather than modifying a file other harnesses depend on.

READ-ONLY. The harness extracts the chain's own public.has_perm, public.can_manage_hiring, public.is_org_member and public._tourify_has_columns function bodies, and the public.staff_members CREATE TABLE, BY LINE RANGE at run time, so the emulated authority is the chain's bytes rather than a paraphrase that could drift. The policy bodies the three permissive predecessors came from are also read from 20250818120000. 20260823210000 was read because it is the migration that turned out to have already dropped the three policies, which is the correction this task records; 20260821031214 was read only to model the staff_shifts_scoped_* shape and its staff_shifts objects were NOT modified.

Acceptance criterion 5 requires the apply to remain a manual CP-051 operator step, and the task asked for a clear operator manifest. Per docs/engineering/handoffs/README.md a cross-domain step is a handoff, not an inline note, so the manifest is a handoff to release with cc to security-admin, admin, workforce, orchestrator and qa.
